artifactDescriptor.normalizationRule: Before authority resolution, normalize artifact frontmatter, a sidecar manifest or another durable machine-readable record to this descriptor. A candidate missing any required field is not authoritative.
artifactDescriptor.pathRule: path identifies the artifact within the current project or tool context; basename alone never defines role.
artifactDescriptor.provenanceRule: provenance should identify approval, acceptance or explicit user designation when that evidence is required by the artifact role.

authorityDomains.scope: Confirmed audience, business outcome, capabilities, constraints, proof, terminology and settled product facts. Neither skill may silently rewrite these facts to satisfy its own output.
Offer, positioning, persuasion strategy, claims, authoritative commercial copy and the constraints attached to that copy.
Visual direction, design implementation, rendered evaluation, accepted visual-system output and design-side surface coordination.

artifactRoles.whenOwnerAbsent: Use confirmed project or user product truth. Missing facts stay unresolved; neither skill may invent them.
Design Studio remains fully usable with user-supplied or repository copy and its local surface-copy coordination rules. That fallback does not claim Growth Arsenal methodology or strategy authority.
Growth Arsenal remains fully usable without Design Studio. It may format its own reports, but those internal presentation assets do not become project visual-design authority.

precedence.modeRule: For preserve-world work, accepted project DESIGN.md governs visual decisions. For greenfield or explicit redesign work, the selected direction governs active visual choices while retained product and brand commitments still apply.

conflicts.effect: Mark the conflicting offer/copy artifact stale or unresolved and return the contradiction to the copy authority or user. Never change confirmed facts to fit copy.
Mark affected offer/copy claims and visual assumptions stale. Revalidate dependent artifacts before acceptance.

Design Studio may adapt composition within accepted visual authority, but it must not silently truncate, weaken or rewrite strategic copy. If the trade-off cannot be satisfied in both domains, return it to the copy authority or user.

Growth Arsenal decides authoritative wording and claims; Design Studio decides visual expression. A cross-domain decision with no compatible solution remains unresolved for the user rather than being won by prompt order.
Apply the role/scope/provenance resolution order. If more than one candidate still has equal authority, halt the dependent decision and request an explicit designation instead of guessing.

invalidates: offer-copy assumptions that depend on the changed fact
visual assumptions that depend on the changed fact
surface briefs and layouts that depend on superseded wording
preserves: accepted visual system unless the user explicitly reopens it

invalidates: surface-specific visual assumptions tied to the superseded system

integrationRules: Design Studio consumes compatible approved offer/copy artifacts by declared role, project scope and approval evidence; it does not invoke, copy or reimplement Growth Arsenal internal methods.
Growth Arsenal remains independently usable and is not expected to duplicate Design Studio visual direction, implementation or rendered-evaluation methods.

A Growth Arsenal repository-internal DESIGN.md or token file is report/tooling presentation state unless it is explicitly exported as project visual-design authority and accepted by Design Studio or the user.
Skill installation order, prompt order, filename alone and file modification time never create authority.
